messages.subject: unable to load shared object - Compile
parts:
Hi everyone,

I tried to solve it by myself but I can't even guess what is happening.

Whe running this simple model, I get an issue at the end:

FrecAvi <- read.csv("FrecAvi.csv", sep=";",dec=",")
Y <- as.numeric(FrecAvi$Frec)

# Modelo con Nimble

mc <- nimbleCode({
  for(i in 1:N){
    Y[i] ~ dnegbin(pp, 5)
  }
  pp ~ dbeta(2, 5)
})

modeldata <- list(Y=Y)
modelinits <- list(pp=0.9)
modelconst <- list(N=40)

model <- nimbleModel(code = mc, name = "model", constants = modelconst, data = modeldata, inits = modelinits)
nimbleOptions(showCompilerOutput = TRUE)
Cmodel <- compileNimble(model)
